title: WPT reviewed license texts (data/reviewed-license-texts.json): the outcome of a review of each license file, notice, package metadata or README text that a source drafter's rules could not identify alone, which the source drafters read (docs/licenses.md, "Reviewed license texts")

schema.description: shape version of this file, for migrations

texts.description: by key: the sha256 of the text's group (its first 200,000 bytes read as UTF-8, lowercased, without the lines naming a copyright, then every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 made one space, trimmed), or "file:" and the sha256 of one file's bytes, which comes first (wpt_dataset.licenses.reviewed)

kind.description: license: the text is the license `license` names; notice: it names that license without its text; not-a-license: it grants nothing (a guideline, a pointer to another file); out: what it covers is left out of the source, for the reason `why`; readme-ok: a README whose words about AI or machine learning refuse no training

license.description: the SPDX expression of a license or a notice

why.description: why what an `out` text covers is left out

recheck.description: why the review is to be read again

spdx.description: the SPDX expression the review found, "" for none
